messages.content: ASSEMBLED_AT_CALL_TIME by app/agent.py from agent/prompt.md + policies.md + guardrails.md + tier + customer context. See app/agent.py assemble_prompt.

serverTools.name: verify_identity
serverTools.description: Check the caller's security answer. Call first, max twice.

serverTools.name: get_failed_payment
serverTools.description: Failed payment details. Refuses until verify_identity succeeds.

serverTools.name: send_payment_link
serverTools.description: Single-use expiring link to the number on file. Verified callers only.

serverTools.name: request_human_handoff
serverTools.description: Queue a human takeover with a reason.

serverTools.name: log_outcome
serverTools.description: Close the call with an outcome. Always call this last.

notes: Replace BASE_URL with the deployed origin (e.g. the cloudflared URL). System prompt is assembled per call, never pasted here.
